reason: The bone-lineage environment signals stem-cell descendants toward the bone-forming lineage described in the chapter.
expectation: Some descendants should begin developing into bone-forming cells.

effect: The lineage produced osteoblasts and embedded osteocytes, which can now contribute to the mature bone model.
reaction: The distinction between matrix-producing osteoblasts and embedded osteocytes is useful.
reason: The collagen framework and calcium phosphate mineral are the visible structural components of bone.
expectation: The mineral should be added to the collagen framework to form a mineralized arm skeleton.

effect: The framework is now mineralised, with collagen contributing toughness and mineral helping resist compression.
reaction: The contrast between the two materials makes their roles clear.
reason: The chapter calls for living bone cells in the mature bone framework.
expectation: The bone cells should be incorporated into the mineralised framework.

effect: The mineralised bones now contain connected living cells; blood vessels are the remaining visible component for supporting them.
reaction: The tiny channels explain how embedded cells remain connected.
reason: Blood vessels should supply the living bone tissue before the elbow is assembled.
expectation: The bones should gain a blood supply.

effect: The arm bones now have vessels supplying nutrients to their embedded cells.
reaction: The cutaway makes the route from vessel to bone cells easier to follow.
reason: Articular cartilage should cap the bone surfaces where they meet at the elbow.
expectation: The joint surfaces should gain smooth cartilage caps.

effect: The elbow-facing bone surfaces now have cartilage caps that slide against each other.
reaction: The sliding inset makes the caps' role clear.
reason: The synovial capsule should enclose the joint and its lubricating fluid.
expectation: The capsule should surround the cartilage-covered elbow joint.

effect: The elbow is enclosed by a capsule whose lining supplies fluid to help its surfaces glide.
reaction: The connection between the lining and joint fluid is useful.
reason: The remaining elbow ligaments should support the joint while allowing movement.
expectation: The ligaments should connect and stabilize the bones at the elbow.

effect: The ligaments completed the movable arm skeleton, showing elbow bending while resisting sideways movement.
reaction: The final cutaway makes the ligaments' stabilising role clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Mineralising the collagen framework was most worthwhile: the planned inset connects the materials to toughness and resistance to compression.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sequence of adding cartilage and then the capsule was predictable, though the planned cutaways explained their roles.

surprise.text: The lineage picture showed osteoblasts becoming embedded osteocytes, and the later cutaway showed how channels connect those cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the available components and chapter goal made their intended roles reasonably clear.

continue.text: I would continue to see how further structures build on this skeleton, although the mostly predictable assembly offered few difficult decisions.
